entries.title: Proverbs 5:2
segments: Thy lips; when the heart is stored with knowledge it dwells also on the lips, and is communicated to others.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:4
segments:
Her end; the final end of yielding to her enticements. 
 
When we are tempted to sinful indulgence, we should consider well its consequences.  It is a sad exchange to give property, health, character, peace of conscience, the favor of God, and everlasting life, for a little momentary pleasure.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:5
segments: Go down to death--take hold on hell; compare

entries.title: Proverbs 5:6
segments: Movable; changeable; she cunningly alters her demeanor so as to retain her hold on those whom she has enticed.  Or the verse may be rendered thus: Lest she should ponder the path of life, her ways wander, she knows not where.  Compare

entries.title: Proverbs 5:8
segments: The only safety of the young lies in avoiding the beginnings of impurity in word, thought, and deed, and all solicitations thereto.  He who needlessly places himself in the way of temptation, is in imminent danger of falling.  And when he once yields, he gives sinful passion the mastery over himself, and his course is rapidly downward, till it ends in the destruction of soul, body, and estate.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:9
segments:
Honor--years; the prime and vigor of thy life. 
 
  Others--the cruel; these words probably refer to the husband of the adulteress, who had a right, by the Levitical law, to demand the death of the offender, but might content himself with the exaction of heavy fines and hard servitude.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:10
segments:
vv 10-11. 
 
  Filled with thy wealth--are consumed; these words refer to all the ways in which illicit indulgence wastes the estate of the transgressor, destroys his health and character, and exposes him to ignominious penalties.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:12
segments: They who will not listen in youth to the admonitions of wisdom, must pay a dreadful penalty for their heedlessness in old age.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:14
segments: The congregation and assembly; the public assembly before which the adulterer was arraigned.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:15
segments:
Drink waters; be content with the wife of thy youth. 
 
God has ordained marriage for the holiness, comfort, and purity of the human family; and all who in any way dishonor it, by precept or example, are among the worst enemies of mankind.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:16
segments: Fountains--rivers of waters; flowing from the well mentioned in the preceding verse.  These may denote either the pure enjoyment which he has in her society, or their mutual offspring.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:21
segments: We can neither conceal from God any crime, nor prevent his exposing and punishing it.  As certainly as he reigns in heaven, every iniquity, unless it be repented of and forgiven through the blood of Christ, will take the sinner in its fatal cords, and hold him fast bound to all eternity.
